Chapter 1055: Chapter 10 Eye of Myriad Laws and Martial Arts Evolution Road (Please Subscribe)

“I’ve just been crowned king. Logically, I should proceed cautiously, but there isn’t enough time.”

Spirit Might King thought to himself, “In just a million years, Father will abdicate. By then, the new emperor will be chosen from the ranks of the royal kings.”

Self-Dao Realm experts generally have no issues with lifespan limitations, and anyone who becomes an emperor of an Ancient Country—no matter how unimpressive their strength may seem—would surely far exceed the Self-Dao Realm.

Therefore.

In the Source World, emperors of the Ancient Countries can serve no more than three hundred million years.

Once they surpass three hundred million years, they must step down, and the next emperor will be selected from among the emperor candidates.

“I have no reputation, no power, and only a million years to position myself as an emperor candidate. It’s simply impossible.”

Spirit Might King had always harbored an ambition to become the emperor of an Ancient Country.

An Ancient Country’s emperor wields the supreme treasure bestowed by the progenitor, which yields great benefits for personal cultivation and further refining one’s bloodline.

Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouses may dismiss the royal family, but they absolutely dare not underestimate the emperor of an Ancient Country, who is nearly equivalent to the progenitor’s ‘spokesperson’ within the nation.

“If I lack reputation, then I’ll build it. The simplest way is to expand the Ancient Country’s territories.”

Spirit Might King’s gaze became profound as he set his sights on Qingfen City, a region within the Qingfen Domain—a domain he had schemed over for many years.

As long as Qingfen Domain falls into his hands, it would quickly lead to sweeping influence across dozens, if not hundreds, of surrounding domains in a short timespan.

By then, conquering dozens or a hundred domains for the Ancient Country would make him a strong contender for emperor, even if his qualifications were initially lacking.

“Your Highness plans to launch a war?”

Marquis Purple Dream cautiously asked.

“What’s the matter?”

Spirit Might King glanced at Marquis Purple Dream.

“Nothing. It’s just that war requires a great deal of preparation time…”

Marquis Purple Dream said.

If they stuck to their initial plan, Qingfen City could be taken within half a day or even less.

However, war comes with logistical challenges and preparation. The opposing side will also have time to prepare, leading to numerous clashes.

No matter how efficient they are, it would still take hundreds of years from preparation to the actual outbreak of war.

“Then go prepare immediately.”

Spirit Might King frowned, then looked toward the other figures standing around him. “For this war, I want all of you ready to act at any time.”

“Understood.”

The assembled figures responded at once.

As a royal king, Spirit Might King had the authority to initiate war.

Of course, possessing the authority to wage war is one thing; if the war is lost and the Ancient Country suffers heavy losses, Spirit Might King would bear full responsibility.

Conversely, if the war is won, Spirit Might King would reap enormous rewards.

Even so, initiating war was not something any royal king undertook lightly. The risks were too high, and even among Ancient Countries, victory was by no means guaranteed.

Spirit Might King, driven by his eagerness to elevate his own reputation, was taking a calculated risk.

…..

Qingfen City.

Lin Yuan was cultivating within the Sky Burning Court.

At that moment—

“Yu Yan, come out for a moment.” Lord Qingfen’s voice called out.

Lin Yuan responded immediately, leaving the Sky Burning Court and heading to the City Lord’s Mansion.

This was also where Lord Qingfen usually cultivated.

At this moment, there were two figures within the mansion engaged in pleasant conversation.

The figure on the left was Lord Qingfen, while the one on the right was an ordinary-looking middle-aged man.

The middle-aged man’s aura was restrained, making him seem like an average person. Yet his eyes were tranquil and warm, as though they contained the expanse of worlds.

Seated there, he emanated an invisible, boundless vitality from the surrounding space, making others instinctively want to draw closer.

“Great Venerate Hongye?”

Lin Yuan instantly recognized the middle-aged man upon seeing him.

Within Sky Burning Court’s vast collection of ancient texts and inheritances, one particular ‘miscellany’ detailed information about all Great Lords and Heavenly Venerate-level experts across Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the neighboring Ancient Countries.

Among them, Great Venerate Hongye was particularly renowned.

Great Venerate Hongye was not appointed as a marquis by any Ancient Country. He disliked being bound by restrictions and therefore had not accepted an official title.

In terms of strength, Great Venerate Hongye surpassed Lord Qingfen, having comprehended both the Chaos Flame and Chaos Life paths.

Using the Chaos Rule as the foundation to evolve countless paths—this was the road that many Great Lords in the Source World aimed to traverse.

“Yu Yan, Brother Hongye is quite interested in your Myriad Formation Crystal.” Lord Qingfen spoke up.

“Great Venerate Hongye.” Lin Yuan immediately greeted him.

He quietly observed the Great Lord, sensing the dual energies coursing through Hongye’s being: one of blazing heat and one of life.

“To use Chaos Life as fuel for igniting Chaos Flame—indeed, Great Venerate Hongye’s strength is fearsome.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Although he could barely muster Great Lord-level combat power through layers of accumulated resources and techniques, in terms of rule comprehension, he was still not at the level of these truly powerful Great Lords.

Moreover, Great Venerate Hongye’s strength was already at the peak of the Great Lord realm, nearly approaching the Heavenly Venerate level.

“Lord Yu Yan.”

Great Venerate Hongye spoke in a gentle tone, while also observing this newly-risen Great Lord.

“Hmm?”

Great Venerate Hongye was slightly startled internally. He couldn’t sense any Chaos Rule evolution fluctuations from Lin Yuan, which was reasonable since such effects could be concealed.

However, Great Venerate Hongye faintly perceived the terrifying depth of Lin Yuan’s physical body.

“What an extraordinary body—a Fierce Sun Divine Body of remarkably high quality, and it seems to contain some profound foundation? An immeasurable root of weight?”

Great Venerate Hongye wondered silently.

Given his realm, he naturally couldn’t see into the depths of Lin Yuan’s physical body, let alone glimpse the universe within it. But he felt the weightiness emanating from Lin Yuan, seemingly exceeding the vastness of the world itself.
